 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Full-width/full-height lines in a non-background color divide the canvas
    # into panels. Full background-colored rows/columns are not separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                and grid[0][c] != background]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rb) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri] + 1, rb[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(cb) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci] + 1, cb[ci + 1]
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            panels.append((sum(v != background for v in cells), r0, r1, c0, c1))
    if not panels:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The populated panel is the exemplar; copy its pattern into every panel.
    _, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(panels, key=lambda p: p[0])
    template = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        ph, pw = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
        for dr in range(min(ph, len(template))):
            for dc in range(min(pw, len(template[dr]))):
                out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = template[dr][dc]
    return out
"
}
